audience: product teams that run a public feedback board in Nolt

useCases.title: Find the top-voted feature requests
useCases.text: Sort the board posts by top votes or by newest. Search the posts for a word and read the vote and comment counts.

useCases.title: Read a post with its comments and votes
useCases.text: Open one post with its excerpt, status and comments. List its votes when the board does not keep voters private.

useCases.title: Check post statuses and board users
useCases.text: List the board's post statuses and the board users. Use the statuses to read the state of each post.

useCases.title: Publish a new feature request
useCases.text: Publish a new feedback post as the acting board user. This needs a write-enabled API key.

useCases.title: Comment on a post and vote for it
useCases.text: Add a comment to a post and set your vote on it. Repeating the same vote changes nothing.
